title: inference_batch.entry.v1
description: Consolidated inference-batch entry (batch-infra item B1 / Wave-1 W0a). One exhaustively-specified inference-gated task with pre-decided Gate/Evidence/Fork tables. Validated by scripts/coordination/compile_inference_batch.py (jsonschema Draft-07). The three semantic lint rules (non-empty owning_handoff, non-empty checkbox, >=1 gate_table row) are enforced by the compiler's lint pass, NOT by this schema, so that lint failures are reported distinctly from structural schema failures.

schema_version.description: Optional schema tag; defaults to inference_batch.entry.v1.

notes.description: Free-form human commentary; ignored by the compiler.

entry_hash.description: Injected by the compiler (canonical sha256 of the entry). Not authored by hand; present so a compiled manifest entry round-trips through this schema.

task_id.description: Stable unique key. Matches the ledger row task_id and dependency references.

provenance.description: Where this task comes from and what it flips. owning_handoff + checkbox non-emptiness is enforced by the compiler lint pass.

owning_handoff.description: Repo-relative path to the handoff that owns this task (e.g. handoffs/active/foo.md).

checkbox.description: The specific checkbox in the owning handoff this task completes (e.g. 'TR-5.2').

also_flips.description: Additional checkbox refs (handoff#checkbox) this task's completion flips.

source_ref.description: Research deep-dive / spec / commit this task derives from.

phase.description: Primary ordering key (ascending). Lower phases run first.

priority.description: Secondary ordering key within a phase. P0 = most urgent.

stack_lineup.description: Required orchestrator stack lineup (human description or lineup id).

flags_required.description: Map of runtime flag name -> required value that MUST be set.

flags_forbidden.description: Flag names that MUST NOT be set.

flag_attestation.description: How deeply the flag state must be attested before execution.

models.description: Model ids / aliases that must be resident.

cache_state.description: Required page-cache state, e.g. drop_caches / warm / any.

contention_matrix.description: content_hash of the contention matrix that must be fresh, or 'not_required'.

autopilot.description: Required autopilot state at execution time.

operator_gates.description: Operator-gate ids (e.g. OP-6) that must be granted. NOT evaluated by the structural pending() check.

depends_on.description: task_ids that must reach a terminal-success state before this entry is eligible.

protocol_id.description: Measurement protocol id (MEASUREMENT.md) this execution follows.

expected.description: Human description of the expected outcome.

gate_table.description: Tri-role Gate/Evidence/Fork rows. Non-emptiness (>=1 row) is enforced by the compiler lint pass, not this schema.

package_to.description: Operator-bundle / package destination for this task's outputs.

era_stamp.description: Instrument era label to stamp on ledger rows (instrument_eras.yaml).

gate_row.description: One decision row in the tri-role Gate/Evidence/Fork style: the Gate is the question, Evidence is what resolves it, Fork is the pre-decided action per verdict.

gate.description: The decision question this row resolves.

fork_branch.description: A pass/marginal/fail branch: the rule that selects it, the actions to take, and the next task_id or terminal ledger status.

next.description: Next task_id to schedule, or a terminal ledger status.

fork_infra.description: Infra-failure branch: classify the infra fault, take remediation actions. No next (re-queues the same task).

fork_ambiguous.description: Ambiguous-evidence branch: hold for operator adjudication.
